column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 3: Kederon / Michette reunion
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: If he's about your age, that's entirely possible!
If I lived in this village, I'd have moved out ages ago...
it's entirely possible those old men got to him already...
What? Waking me up in broad daylight when I'm sleepy...
The boy named $$パルタ$$ who lived here...?
I don't know anyone like that! ...Wait.
I thought you'd suddenly vanished, and then you just pop back up at my side...
You white $$羽$$ $$奴隷$$s think you can talk back to me?!
If I say you're $$カイン$$, then you're $$カイン$$!!
What did you call me, woman?!
Think about it: he spent a long time asleep with $$記憶喪失$$...
That means, regarding his own $$記憶$$ of the past,
he has no confidence in them at all...
Put another way, the old stories his $$ご主人$$ told him...
may not be true at all... That is entirely possible!!
So you mean this guy really is that...
I am saying it is possible...
Are you really not my $$カイン$$...?!
I see... Then you couldn't possibly...
be interested in me, could you!?
You're in my way! Get out of here already!!
Yeah, right! Being told something like that all of a sudden...
To prove that you're truly $$カイン$$...
$$ミシェット$$ has joined the party!
Aah! I knew there was absolutely no mistake~!!
I have no use for any of you! Right, $$カイン$$~?!
All right, let's do the usual!
Yaaay!! This is a home for me and my $$ヌイグルミさん達$$ only!
perhaps this was for the best...
